subcategory_gloss: insurance claims, billing rules, benefit adjudication
domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by workers' compensation temporary disability adjudication: which payroll pay belongs to which earned week, the base period and average weekly wage, the statutory rate as a fraction of wage bounded by the maximum and minimum in force on the date of injury, the waiting period and when it is paid back, and partial disability from wage loss. The deliverable is the indemnity benefit statement a claims unit issues on an insurance claim, not software behaviour for its own sake; this is wage-replacement indemnity, distinct from medical cost sharing (tbrain-health-plan-cost-sharing).
evidence: instruction.md: the manual is 'the authority for these indemnity statements'; symptoms are adjudication outcomes (average weekly wages against payroll registers, weekly rates, maximum by injury year, low-wage rate, waiting period)

environment/app/docs/td-benefits-manual.md: a numbered claims-unit benefits manual (week's pay, base period, week of partial disability, row in force on the date of injury, waiting period and retroactive days, wage loss)

planned verifier (step 4 onward): whole-statement comparison of AWW, rate, waiting/retroactive/paid days and amounts against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, which is derived from the manual
task.toml: category Operations, subcategory Claims, tag insurance-claims-benefit-adjudication echoes the gloss
